title: _cmd_set_lanes accepts alloc totals below 100, silently stranding pipe capacity
detail: Only total>100 is rejected; a sub-100 alloc (e.g. [30,30,20]) is applied, and since each lane's reserve is budget*share/100, the unallocated budget remainder is spendable by no lane.
recommended_fix: Reject totals != 100 (or normalize reserves by the alloc sum) in _cmd_set_lanes so every accepted command fully describes the pipe's capacity split.

title: _on_rung fallback assigns lane 0 without verifying Express is active
detail: Unconditional `lane = 0` can target an inactive Express. Current LADDER values always leave lane 0 or 1 active, but any retuned LADDER rung (SimBalance is the declared tuning table) silently makes the rung click a sim-rejected no-op.
recommended_fix: Pick the fallback from active lanes: iterate lanes 0..2 and select the first with _alloc[lane] > 0, matching _on_class_cycle's order-building.
